features.description: Open-source agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal; installed via standalone script or npm.
Official extensions for VS Code, JetBrains IDEs, and the Zed editor.
Official desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
`qwen serve`/`qwen daemon` runs a browser Web Shell, an HTTP + SSE API, multiple workspaces, and session reconnect.
Runs as a bot in Telegram, DingTalk, WeChat, or Feishu via `qwen channel start`.
Non-interactive `qwen -p` prompt mode for automation and custom integrations.
Other agents (Claude, Codex, etc.) can delegate coding tasks to Qwen Code over the Agent Client Protocol ('Qwen Code Claw'); a voice frontend runs over ACP.
Next-generation harness (co-developed with Qoder) with Terminal TUI, Headless, and ACP entry points, a persistent AppServer runtime, task orchestration, and permission control.
Documented CI/CD automation with Qwen Code in GitHub Actions.

Qwen Account (Plus/Pro subscription), QwenCloud token plans or pay-as-you-go keys, Alibaba ModelStudio coding/token plans, third-party providers (DeepSeek, Grok, MiniMax, Z.AI, Kimi, OpenRouter, Requesty), or a custom local server.
Works with OpenAI-, Anthropic-, Gemini-, and Qwen-compatible APIs; third-party providers and local models (Ollama/vLLM), switchable at runtime.
Five permission modes: Plan, Ask Permissions, Auto-Edit, Auto (classifier-evaluated), and YOLO.
Read-only permission mode for code exploration and planning complex changes; no edits or shell execution.
Linux sandboxing via Bubblewrap/Landlock with filesystem and network profiles, plus whole-CLI sandbox methods.
QWEN.md instruction files, self-written auto-memory notes, and optional external memory (Mem0 or a local session index via the context_search MCP tool).
Automatic shadow-git snapshots before every file modification, restorable with `/restore` (files + conversation).
SKILL.md-based skills with optional scripts/resources that the model invokes on demand.
Task-specific agents with their own context and tool access; built-ins delegate to separately installed Claude Code and Codex.
Agent Teams for collaboration plus an experimental file-based Agent Board (`qwen board`) where independently started agents claim and complete shared tasks.
Connect Model Context Protocol servers for additional tools and context.
`/review` for local diffs or GitHub PRs with inline comments, auto-fix, resume, and effort levels.
`/loop` and cron-style scheduling for repeating prompts, polling, and reminders, with a persistent scheduler for chat channels.
web_search tool enabled automatically when authenticating with QwenCloud or Alibaba ModelStudio.
Prompt caching to reduce cost on repeated context.
TUI theme customization and QwenIgnore file-exclusion rules.
The CLI is free open-source; model usage is billed via Qwen Plus/Pro subscriptions, QwenCloud, or Alibaba ModelStudio API plans.
